title: AppProtection and the older Inspection names
aliases: is inspection the same as appprotection

prose.text: The console and help say AppProtection, while the SDKs, API paths and Terraform resources still say Inspection.

prose.label: Terraform and Go.
prose.text: {{terraform-names}} {{go-package-names}} Provider and SDK defects for these objects are in [[zpa.terraform.app-segment-lifecycle]] and [[zpa.sdk-go.service-defects]].

checks.do: Which name the object in front of you uses, and map it: SDK class and API path say inspection, console and help say AppProtection.

property-vs-class.statement: In the Python SDK, client.zpa.app_protection returns an InspectionControllerAPI, and its docstring calls it the ZPA Inspection interface.

quotes: The interface object for the :ref:`ZPA Inspection interface <zpa-app_protection>`.

api-path-names.statement: The management API serves AppProtection profiles under inspectionProfile and AppProtection controls under inspectionControls.

schema-says-appprotection.statement: The inspectionProfile request schema describes its objects as AppProtection profiles and AppProtection controls.

expect.description: The time the AppProtection profile is created.
The set of AppProtection controls used to define how inspections are managed.

terraform-names.statement: The Terraform provider registers AppProtection profiles and custom controls as zpa_inspection_profile and zpa_inspection_custom_controls.

go-package-names.statement: The Go SDK keeps the inspection name in its package layout: inspection_profile, under services/inspectioncontrol.

same-product.statement: The objects named Inspection in the SDK, API and Terraform are the AppProtection profiles and controls of the console.
same-product.conditions: Inferred from the API schema describing inspectionProfile objects as AppProtection profiles. No captured source states a rename or its date, or that every Inspection-named object is AppProtection.
